coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 8 ground-truth variable items (38%, rounded): both query directions, retrieval accuracy, and a shared pipeline of dataset-creation, testing, scoring, and visualization scripts.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the IMDb top-1000 dataset and GPT-4-verified pairs with Wikidata/Wikipedia dyads; substitutes GPT, Claude, and Llama-3 models for the specified GPT-3.5-turbo and Llama sizes; omits the chat-versus-completion manipulation; fixes temperature at 0 instead of varying it by model/regime; and uses McNemar and other analyses instead of the specified t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected directional-bias conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that child-to-parent retrieval should outperform parent-to-child retrieval, confirming the reversal curse in real-world knowledge.
